name: Zoe
operatingSystem: Text messaging (SMS and iMessage). No app download.
description: Zoe is AI that helps you walk with Jesus. It lives in your text messages (SMS and iMessage) and helps people turn their attention toward Jesus more often through scripture, prayer, reflection, memory, and gentle follow-through. The daily rhythm is a morning anchor, a midday nudge, and an evening reflection, with conversation any time in between. Zoe is explicitly AI: not a pastor, person, friend, therapist, or replacement for the Holy Spirit or the local church.

offers.description: Free during the beta, through October 14, 2026. Starting October 15, 2026, Zoe becomes a paid subscription. People who joined during the beta keep a founding price of $4.99/month. Pricing for new members has not been announced.

availability: Beta. Public signup joins a waitlist; Zoe invites people in small groups and texts them when a spot is ready.
keywords: AI that helps you walk with Jesus
dailyRhythm: Morning anchor: a passage, useful context when it helps (historical, cultural, or original-language), and a reflection question
Midday nudge: a short text that brings the morning back into real life
Evening reflection: a question or two to close the loop on the day
Conversation any time: text Zoe about scripture, a decision, a hard conversation, or something to remember
featureList: Lives in your text messages (SMS and iMessage); no app, no login
Morning anchor, midday nudge, and evening reflection, with timing the user controls
Memory and follow-through: remembers what you are reading, wrestling with, and said mattered, and checks back later
Prayer reminders: helps you remember to pray for the people and situations you name, and follows up to ask how things are going
Journeys: pre-made paths (for example James, anxiety, marriage, grief, rest) or custom plans such as reading Philippians over two weeks

Rule-of-life layer: helps you set a small set of rhythms (one daily practice, one weekly practice, one relational rhythm, one weekly review) and quietly helps you keep it; no streaks, points, or badges
Text STOP any time to stop messages
Church version: shaped by a church's teaching and guardrails; pastors see aggregate patterns only

uses: Remembering context across days and following up at the right time
Choosing and delivering scripture for a Journey or reading plan
Adding historical, cultural, or original-language context when it helps
Asking reflection questions and helping users put words to prayer
Conversational replies when a user texts, within theological and safety guardrails
doesNotDo: Pray for users as though it has spiritual agency (it helps users pray and reminds them who they said they would pray for)
Speak for God or tell users what God is saying to them
Claim feelings, consciousness, or an inner life
Act as a pastor, counselor, therapist, or spiritual director
Give church leaders access to private conversations by default
aiCapabilities.designPhilosophy: Use AI to help people pay attention to Jesus; do not let AI become the center of attention. Zoe is designed to point people toward Jesus, scripture, prayer, faithful action, their church, and real human relationships, not toward more time with Zoe.

privacy: Conversations are private by default and Zoe does not sell user data. During beta a small team may review relevant context for bug reports, feedback, safety, or support. In the church version, leaders see aggregate patterns, not private messages, prayers, confessions, or individual growth.
theologicalPosture: Default version is broadly Protestant and non-denominational, grounded in historic Christian orthodoxy (C.S. Lewis's Mere Christianity is the reference point). Acknowledges a range of views on disputed questions and asks more than it declares. Church versions can set their own statement of faith and guardrails.
nameMeaning: Zoe is the Greek word the New Testament uses for the life only God gives (John 1:4). The product is named after the life it cannot give, on purpose.

audience.audienceType: Christians who want to walk more closely with Jesus but keep losing the thread during the day; pastors and churches who want Sunday's teaching to carry into Monday through Saturday

church.summary: Zoe helps a church's people carry Sunday's sermon into Monday through Saturday. Zoe supports the pastor's work; it does not replace the pastor or speak with the pastor's authority.
church.visibility: Pastors see shared, aggregate patterns and themes, not private text threads or individual growth. Members can choose to share something specific.
church.status: Church pilots are starting; request one at https://zoe.live/churches/start

comparison.vsYouVersion: YouVersion is a free, full-featured Bible app with translations, reading plans, and audio. Zoe is not a Bible library; it lives in your texts and focuses on daily rhythm, memory, and follow-through. Many people could reasonably use both.
comparison.vsHallow: Hallow is an audio prayer and meditation app rooted in Catholic tradition. Zoe is text-based, conversational, and broadly Protestant and non-denominational by default.
comparison.vsGeneralAI: General AI assistants can explain passages and history but are not designed around a daily rhythm, follow-through, or pointing users toward church and real relationships. Zoe is built with those guardrails.
